text:
Miriam K: Dropped a micro-proto for prompt-set compare + approval modal in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123. Main asks: make regressions discoverable without noise, show scorecard earlier, and tidy CTA copy for keyboard users. PTAL.

Devin R: Noticed the deletion red is too low-contrast on white. Suggest #b02a37 or #8c1f2a (both pass AA). Also diff rows have no visible focus ring when tabbing.

Ash Patel: Accessibility: each diff row should be a semantic button (aria-expanded + aria-controls) and include a short visually-hidden summary like "Regression: test X -12%". Add an aria-live region for new diffs but debounce updates.

Sam O'Neill: PM ask: include an "Approve with notes" inline expansion (not buried in a menu) and surface a condensed scorecard in the modal header (pass % + regression delta + top example).

DesignBot: regression-bot: alert for prompt-set 211: 2 regressions, avg delta -11%. Report: https://dash/reports/211

Miriam K: Proposed CTA behavior: visual label "Approve & Promote" but short programmatic label "Promote" so keyboard shortcut can be 'P' and UI stays compact. Also add tooltip that shows full text.

Devin R: CSS suggestion for focus ring: `.diff-row:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; }` I'll add color swatches to figma.

Ash Patel: Quick ARIA sketch for modal: `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="approve-heading" aria-describedby="scorecard-summary"` and the inline notes expansion must be reachable by 'N' and not trap focus. I'll write a short QA script for screen reader + keyboard flows.

Miriam K: Decisions: (1) swap to higher-contrast deletion red (Devin to pick), (2) condensed scorecard in modal header, (3) visual CTA = "Approve & Promote", programmatic label = "Promote" with shortcut 'P', (4) inline "Approve with notes" expansion under primary CTA, (5) diff rows keyboard-focusable with aria-expanded. Action owners: @Devin R colors + figma tokens, @Ash Patel ARIA + QA script, @Sam O'Neill acceptance criteria + data examples, @Miriam K prototype. Target: staging prototype by next Wed. :thumbsup:
